integrity: The finite spectral classification is proved by an exact exhaustive computation in Q(omega) over all 18 two-image maps and all 216 projective qutrit Clifford elements. The computation uses no floating-point step as evidence. The analytic reduction to the full second-moment spectrum is stated explicitly, and no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to deterministic qutrit measure-and-prepare channels whose classical map has exactly two image points, and to the projective single-qutrit Clifford unitary 2-design. It does not establish the Wallman-Flammia conjecture for arbitrary qutrit channels or arbitrary unitary 2-designs. The originality search was targeted rather than exhaustive.
title: Exact qutrit-Clifford second moments for deterministic two-image classical channels
